div.h1: DL8 LSP as one RxJS program
div.p: Read downward. Each panel owns one kind of state. The six arrows carry envelopes between ownership scopes.

g.text: 1 · MANY CLIENTS ENTER ONE BOUNDED DOOR
2 · PARTITION BY WORKSPACE · OVERLAYS STAY INSIDE SESSIONS
3 · SWITCH TO THE NEWEST SNAPSHOT · OLD WORK CANCELS
4 · TRANSACT OWNED FACTS · sqlite_ivm MOVES THE VIEWS
5 · FOREIGN LANGUAGE SERVERS ARE LEASED RESOURCES
6 · ONE BOOLEAN DECIDES WHETHER AN ANSWER MAY ESCAPE

g.title: Every asynchronous boundary preserves identity and generation.
Sharing follows structural identity rather than URI alone.
Only envelopes cross the transport boundary. Writers and request ids remain session-owned.

div.p: o open · h hover · c change · q query · x close

g.title: One ingress sequence preserves per-source identity.
One shared workspace snapshot is fed by separate per-session overlay reducers.

div.h3: State after two clients edit the same URI

tr.td: keyed by D1 until an overlay query selects DA or DB

div.p: shareReplay(1) retains one current workspace snapshot while leases exist.

g.title: Unsaved bytes never overwrite another session or the saved-file identity.
switchMap cancels the prior computation for one session and URI. Other URIs continue.

div.p: × is cancellation. A late physical completion still meets the generation fence in stage 6.

g.title: Cancellation reduces work. Generation fencing supplies correctness even when cancellation is advisory.
concatMap gives the storage writer a single ordered transaction lane.

div.p: Retraction removes relational state. It does not release process-local owners.

g.title: sqlite_ivm supplies incremental durable views rather than an LSP lifecycle.
using ties the RxJS subscription lifetime to the child-process lease.

pre.code: ABSENT ─first lease→ STARTING ─ready→ LIVE ↑ │ └─joined← STOPPING ←final release──┘ │ deadline ▼ KILLED ─waitpid→ ABSENT

div.p: The final lease closes stdin. A deadline escalates to kill. waitpid precedes ledger removal.

g.title: Process generation changes on every restart, fencing late pipe reads.

pre.code: const published$ = answers$.pipe( withLatestFrom(currentOverlay$, currentProcessGeneration$), filter(([a, overlay, procGen]) => a.generation === overlay.generation && (a.processGeneration == null || a.processGeneration === procGen) && !overlay.closed ), map(([answer]) => answer), groupBy(a => a.session), mergeMap(session$ => session$.pipe( observeOn(writerFor(session$.key)), )), )

g.title: Publication checks session generation, optional child generation and closed state.
Cancellation is an optimization. This table is the correctness boundary.

pre.code: const close$ = sessionClosed$.pipe( concatMap(session => sequence( () => generations.close(session), () => requests.cancelSession(session), () => overlays.delete(session), () => subscribers.delete(session), () => facts.retractSession(session), () => watchers.unregister(session), () => adapters.releaseSession(session), () => writers.drain(session), () => workers.join(session), () => ledger.assertFloor(session), )), )

g.title: The sequence drops sender clones before draining and joining the writer.

div.p: The v5 exit hang belongs at subscribers.delete and writers.drain: retained sender clones kept the writer alive.

g.title: Measured counters distinguish retained handles, resident growth and ordinary shared caches.
